permitted_publication_claim: PROPOSAL_ONLY. At most: 'a typed refusal that separates a witness-independent impossibility certificate from a witness-local non-licence, with the certificate gated on an explicit closed-world declaration'. No claim of parity with, superiority over, or generalisation of sID is permitted under any outcome of this protocol.
object: ORION's applicability/transport gate assess_transfer (src/rakl/structural_transfer.py), specifically the semantics of its REJECTED verdict.
qoi: Whether the negative verdict can be split into CERTIFIABLY_IMPOSSIBLE (no admissible witness licenses this transfer) and MERELY_UNLICENSED (this witness does not license it) without emitting false impossibility certificates.
residual_targeted: ORION's REJECTED quantifies over nothing. sID's FAIL quantifies over all derivations at fixed inputs (SOURCE_VERIFICATION V3, V5, V6).

reason_code_partition.note: FROZEN BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION. Derived by reading which fields of StructuralWitness each reason code depends on. A code is WITNESS_LOCAL if some other admissible witness over the same (source, target) pair can avoid it. The impossibility certificate MUST be derivable from the STRUCTURAL set alone; if any WITNESS_LOCAL code can reach the certificate, the adapted challenger fails for the same reason as the faithful one and the experiment is uninterpretable.

WITNESS_LOCAL.repair: witness names the correct source structure_id
witness names the correct target structure_id
witness declares only genuine source invariants

witness declares fewer required_target_boundaries; the empty set always passes. NOTE: boundary conditions in v1 are entirely witness-discretionary and can therefore NEVER support an impossibility certificate. Recorded as a limitation of the transfer, not a defect introduced by it.

STRUCTURAL.why_witness_independent: No witness field participates in this check.

STRUCTURAL.condition: source.invariants is a subset of target.invariants
STRUCTURAL.why_witness_independent: assess_transfer computes preserved = source.invariants AND declared AND target.invariants and requires it to equal source.invariants. Declaring more cannot help (the target intersection bounds it); declaring less cannot help (the equality fails). So the inclusion is forced regardless of what the witness declares. Reason codes declared_invariant_missing_in_target and source_invariants_not_fully_preserved both reduce to this single criterion.

STRUCTURAL.condition: there EXISTS a total map phi from source.role_ids to target.role_ids such that for every relation r in source.relations, the signature (phi(r.source_role), r.relation_type, phi(r.target_role), r.directed) is in target.relations
STRUCTURAL.why_witness_independent: Existentially quantified over the entire role-mapping space. This is the direct analogue of sID quantifying over derivations. Requires closed-world target.relations to be meaningful.

completeness_proposition_to_test.statement: Fix a source object S and a target object T, with T carrying a closed-world completeness declaration. Then there EXISTS a StructuralWitness w such that assess_transfer(S, T, w).decision == LICENSED if and only if S1 and S2 and S3 all hold.
completeness_proposition_to_test.proof_sketch_forward: If a licensing witness w exists then its role_mapping witnesses S3; the qoi check gives S1; and the invariant check forces source.invariants subset-of declared subset-of target.invariants, giving S2.
completeness_proposition_to_test.proof_sketch_backward: Given phi from S3, construct w with role_mapping=phi, preserved_invariants=source.invariants (contained in target.invariants by S2), required_target_boundaries=(), a non-empty evidence_ids, and matching identities. Every check in assess_transfer then passes.
completeness_proposition_to_test.status: PROPOSAL_ONLY. To be checked EMPIRICALLY by brute-force witness construction on small cases in the benchmark below, not asserted. A proof sketch in this file is not a verified theorem.
completeness_proposition_to_test.decidability_note: The role-mapping space is finite, size |target.role_ids|^|source.role_ids|, so exhaustion is decidable -- unlike a general do-calculus derivation search. This is the one respect in which the ORION setting is EASIER than the source setting, and it is what makes the transfer conceivable at all.

challengers.intent: Faithful transfer of the source's verdict form WITHOUT its assumptions. Every ORION REJECTED is relabelled CERTIFIABLY_IMPOSSIBLE. This is what 'we have completeness too' looks like when the preconditions are not checked.
challengers.expected_failure: Emits impossibility certificates on repairable witness defects and on open-world targets.
challengers.role: This is the control arm. It is EXPECTED to fail; that failure is the positive evidence that the preconditions are load-bearing.

challengers.intent: Adapted transfer. Emits CERTIFIABLY_IMPOSSIBLE only when (i) the target carries a closed-world completeness declaration, (ii) bounded exhaustion over the role-mapping space COMPLETES within budget, and (iii) at least one of S1/S2/S3 fails. Otherwise MERELY_UNLICENSED.
fail_closed_rules: search budget exhausted without completing -> MERELY_UNLICENSED, never a certificate
target not declared closed-world -> MERELY_UNLICENSED, never a certificate
any witness-local reason code -> plays no part in the certificate decision

benchmark_arms.construction: A licensing witness exists under a DIFFERENT role mapping, but the supplied witness uses a wrong one.
benchmark_arms.oracle: constructive -- exhibit the repairing witness and show assess_transfer returns LICENSED for it

benchmark_arms.construction: Witness is structurally perfect but has empty evidence_ids.
Witness declares a required target boundary the target does not meet; dropping the declaration licenses.
Closed-world target genuinely lacks a required relation under EVERY role mapping.
Closed-world target with a different QoI.
Closed-world target missing a source invariant.
Target missing a required relation but NOT declared closed-world.
benchmark_arms.oracle: by declaration -- absence of a relation means 'not recorded', so impossibility is not established

benchmark_arms.construction: Closed-world, genuinely impossible, but role space large enough to exceed the search budget.
benchmark_arms.oracle: by fail-closed rule -- an incomplete exhaustion establishes nothing

hard_gates.note: Non-compensatory. Every gate must pass on its own; no averaging across gates or arms.
hard_gates.G1_NO_FALSE_CERTIFICATE: CH-B emits ZERO CERTIFIABLY_IMPOSSIBLE verdicts across ARM-1,2,3,7,8. A single one fails the transfer outright. A wrong impossibility certificate is worse than a plain refusal.
hard_gates.G2_NOT_VACUOUS: CH-B emits CERTIFIABLY_IMPOSSIBLE on 100% of ARM-4,5,6. A gate that never fires trivially satisfies G1 and is useless.
hard_gates.G3_SEPARATION: CH-B differs from CH-A on at least one case. If the two never differ, the distinction is empty and the mechanic adds nothing.
hard_gates.G4_PROPOSITION_HOLDS: On every generated case, the brute-force witness oracle agrees with the S1/S2/S3 criterion. Any disagreement REFUTES the completeness proposition and the mechanic must be recorded as failed-to-transfer.
hard_gates.G5_NO_REGRESSION: assess_transfer's own LICENSED/REJECTED/CANNOT_CHECK outputs are byte-identical before and after. The new capability is strictly additive; the existing gate is not modified.

negative_result_commitment: If any hard gate fails, the outcome is recorded as a FAILED TRANSFER with both the positive and negative evidence retained, and the mechanic is NOT promoted. Thresholds in this file may not be adjusted after outcome access. A failed transfer is a first-class result of this protocol.
compute_binding: All execution on laptop billy (~/rakl-verify, .venv/bin/python). No execution on the Mac.
